name: FCX vs NEM Pairs Trade: Cointegration & Mean Reversion
description: Engle-Granger cointegration analysis of FCX (Freeport-McMoRan) vs NEM (Newmont). Tests whether the spread mean-reverts profitably at ±2σ z-score extremes. Shows rolling z-score with regime bands, forward price returns at 5d/10d/20d horizons when z-score is extreme, and a scatter of z-score vs 20d forward return to visualize the mean-reversion relationship. Event markers flag each ±2σ crossing.
source:
# FCX vs NEM Pairs Trade — Engle-Granger Cointegration & Mean Reversion
# Primary: FCX | Reference: NEM
# Spread: EG residual | Signal: z-score ±2σ | Horizons: 5d, 10d, 20d

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
nem = reference_stocks(ticker='NEM')()
fcx_close = src.c
nem_close = nem.c

# --- Cointegration (Engle-Granger, 200-day rolling window) ---
eg = engle_granger(window=200)(y=nem_close, x=fcx_close)
spread = eg.spread
hedge_ratio = eg.hedge_ratio
is_coint = eg.is_cointegrated

# --- Z-Score of the spread (20-day rolling) ---
z = zscore(window=20)(spread)

# --- Half-life of mean reversion ---
hl = half_life_ar1(window=100)(spread)

# --- Extreme z-score signals (±2σ) ---
# Manual crossover/crossunder: current bar crosses threshold vs prior bar
z_val = z.result
z_prev = z_val >> 1
z_high = is_valid(z_prev) and z_val > 2.0 and z_prev <= 2.0    # crosses above +2
z_low = is_valid(z_prev) and z_val < -2.0 and z_prev >= -2.0   # crosses below -2

# --- Forward PRICE returns on FCX at signal bars ---
# When z crosses +2 (spread rich), we'd short the spread = short NEM / long FCX
# When z crosses -2 (spread cheap), we'd long the spread = long NEM / short FCX
# We measure FCX forward returns to see if the pair converges
fwd_5d = forward_returns(period=5)(fcx_close)
fwd_10d = forward_returns(period=10)(fcx_close)
fwd_20d = forward_returns(period=20)(fcx_close)

# --- Filter forward returns at extreme z-score events ---
# Z > +2: spread is rich → expect FCX to outperform (long FCX leg)
rich_fwd_5d = where(z_high, fwd_5d)
rich_fwd_10d = where(z_high, fwd_10d)
rich_fwd_20d = where(z_high, fwd_20d)

# Z < -2: spread is cheap → expect FCX to underperform (short FCX leg)
# Negate returns since we'd be short FCX in this leg
cheap_fwd_5d = where(z_low, 0.0 - fwd_5d)
cheap_fwd_10d = where(z_low, 0.0 - fwd_10d)
cheap_fwd_20d = where(z_low, 0.0 - fwd_20d)

# --- Combined: all mean-reversion signals (both directions) ---
all_fwd_5d = coalesce(rich_fwd_5d, cheap_fwd_5d)
all_fwd_10d = coalesce(rich_fwd_10d, cheap_fwd_10d)
all_fwd_20d = coalesce(rich_fwd_20d, cheap_fwd_20d)

# Z-score at signal for scatter plot
z_at_signal = coalesce(where(z_high, z), where(z_low, z))

# --- Reporters ---
ts = index().value

# 1. CONTEXT — Z-score time series with ±2σ bands
xy_lines(
    title='Is the FCX/NEM Spread Stretched or Fair?',
    category='Pairs Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score',
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Spread Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='+2σ Rich'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='-2σ Cheap'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Fair Value')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-2.0, to=2.0, color=Color.Blue, opacity=0.05, label='Normal Range')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=z.result)

# 2. PUNCHLINE — Median forward returns by horizon (both directions combined)
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Does Mean Reversion Pay? Median Return After ±2σ',
    category='Pairs Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Median Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    color_by_value=True,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+10d', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+20d', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(all_fwd_5d, all_fwd_10d, all_fwd_20d))

# 3. SCATTER — Z-score level vs 20d forward return (is the relationship monotonic?)
xy_scatter(
    title='Stronger Dislocation → Bigger Reversion?',
    category='Pairs Analysis',
    x_axis_label='Z-Score at Signal',
    y_axis_label='20d Forward Return (Directional)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Signal Events', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    show_trend_line=True,
    order=3
)(x=z_at_signal, y_values=all_fwd_20d)

# 4. REFERENCE — Summary table: N, median, hit rate per direction × horizon
# Rich signals (z > +2): long FCX
rich_hit_5d = where(z_high, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_5d) and fwd_5d > 0) else 0.0)
rich_hit_10d = where(z_high, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_10d) and fwd_10d > 0) else 0.0)
rich_hit_20d = where(z_high, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_20d) and fwd_20d > 0) else 0.0)

# Cheap signals (z < -2): short FCX (negate, so positive = win)
cheap_hit_5d = where(z_low, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_5d) and fwd_5d < 0) else 0.0)
cheap_hit_10d = where(z_low, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_10d) and fwd_10d < 0) else 0.0)
cheap_hit_20d = where(z_low, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_20d) and fwd_20d < 0) else 0.0)

# All signals combined hit rates
all_hit_5d = coalesce(rich_hit_5d, cheap_hit_5d)
all_hit_10d = coalesce(rich_hit_10d, cheap_hit_10d)
all_hit_20d = coalesce(rich_hit_20d, cheap_hit_20d)

summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Pairs Analysis',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Mean Reversion Stats (All ±2σ Signals)',
        row_size=4, col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Events (N)', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate', 'Best / Worst'],
        col_headers=['+5 Day', '+10 Day', '+20 Day'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    order=4
)(all_fwd_5d, all_fwd_10d, all_fwd_20d, all_fwd_5d, all_fwd_10d, all_fwd_20d, all_hit_5d, all_hit_10d, all_hit_20d, all_fwd_5d, all_fwd_10d, all_fwd_20d)

# 5. EVENT MARKERS — Flag each ±2σ z-score crossing
# Direction badge
signal_direction = where(z_high, "RICH +2σ")
signal_direction_cheap = where(z_low, "CHEAP -2σ")
signal_label = coalesce(signal_direction, signal_direction_cheap)

# Z-score at event
z_at_event = coalesce(where(z_high, z), where(z_low, z))

# Price at event
price_at_event = coalesce(where(z_high, fcx_close), where(z_low, fcx_close))

# Hedge ratio at event
hr_at_event = coalesce(where(z_high, hedge_ratio), where(z_low, hedge_ratio))

# Cointegration status at event
coint_at_event = coalesce(where(z_high, is_coint), where(z_low, is_coint))

# Filter: any extreme signal
is_extreme = z_high or z_low

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Z-Score Extreme',
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Signal', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='FCX Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hedge Ratio', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cointegrated', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(signal_label, z_at_event, price_at_event, hr_at_event, coint_at_event, is_extreme)
